title: Abstract Kit Store and Create Studio Vscode Bundles
description: Abstract the Kit Store completely from sketchpad. Create a new semio bundle called studio that has the yjs kit provider. Pass it as a root prop to Sketchpad. Remove the yjs dependency completely from sketchpad. Create File store (JSON sync) and Folder store (sqlite sync). Create a semio vscode bundle that opens sketchpad when a JSON kit file is opened.
summary: Abstracted Kit Store persistence from sketchpad. Added PersistenceProvider/PersistenceFactory to shared.ts. Removed IndexeddbPersistence from Sketchpad.tsx. Updated entry points to pass IndexeddbPersistence factory. Added File/SQLite persistence factories. Added KitEditorProvider to VS Code extension.
